items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Yeah. Dexter joined us in California.

ctx.x: Back with Teddy McRae. This is Cassette No. 9. You were with Louie and you -- The band, when you were with it, made a few recordings which apparently were never issued until "Grooving" was issued on this Decca Lp, "Louis Armstrong Rare Items, 1935 to 1944," from Decca jazz heritage series. This is DE9225. And "Grooving" is that orchestra recorded in August 9, 1944. I was a couple of months old at that time. Jess Brown, Thomas Gritter, Fats Ford, Lester Curran, were the trumpet sections. And you were in the reed…
Yeah. Dexter joined us in California.
Okay. So in other words, Dexter joined Louie Armstrong after you joined Louie
